description: Answers "did the push I made a few hours ago pass?". Lists the pushes on a repository that finished between 1 and 12 hours ago (or 1 and 4 hours ago), newest first, each with its branch, pull request, title, who pushed it, outcome (passed, failed, awaiting, superseded), when it finished, how long it took, its commit and a link to the run, plus a count of each outcome. Narrow it by branch, pull request, commit (sha, 7 or more characters) or outcome. It does not cover the last hour: for pushes queued, running or finished in the last hour, use ci_status. Read-only, and it never fails: if CI cannot be read it says why.

hours.description: How far back: 4 or 12 hours (default 12). Both read the same 12-hour list.

pr.description: Only pushes for this pull request number.

repo.description: owner/name. Optional when the token covers one repository.

sha.description: Only the push of this commit (its first 7 or more characters).

name: ci_history
title: Finished CI pushes, 1 to 12 hours ago
